estimation.justification: 48k on clarification+exchange and three-turn shortage allows headroom above measured 32,499 pre-dispatch requirement; 40k on shorter return/explicit-shortage paths. No reservation estimator change. Conservative full-request byte bounds and added reasoning may still stop early; ranges are estimates, not guarantees.

retry_rules: No SDK/HTTP automatic retries; no whole-task rerun.
Recoverable tool-order/schema/business feedback may lead to new budgeted model requests within the same task; each counts against all caps.
Read tools may retry locally at most twice; writes never retry blindly. WRITE_RESULT_UNKNOWN queries original receipt, not a new write.
stop_conditions: Before dispatch: hash/code/scenario/diagnostic/approval mismatch, missing key, wrong model/Beijing endpoint, unconfirmed current free quota/protection.
Any authentication/quota/paid protection/provider protocol/security anomaly; usage unknown or inconsistent: stop batch and keep unknown reservations.
Any request/token/turn/conversation/batch deadline or human cancellation: stop, preserve first trajectory; do not append tasks or change model.
Ordinary task failure: save first result, continue only remaining fixed tasks if no batch-stop category; no live code changes.
preconditions: NEW explicit approval bound to this plan hash and frozen repair source; no previous approval/budget is reusable.
Fresh human account confirmation for exact model Beijing free quota >= 176000 and FreeTierOnly active; extra paid budget zero.
Fixed order qp1-03, qp1-04, qp1-07, qp1-08. Each independent fixture resets only aftercare_test. No business-success gate; ordinary failure continues remaining fixed tasks.
Persistent real BudgetLedger stays in aftercare_demo. Per-task token cap bound durably to its ledger conversation and task index; it cannot borrow a different task cap.
No concurrent pytest/evaluator. New batch state and ledger must both show never started. Default workbench remains offline.
Original scenarios/scorer and historical results untouched. New scenario version replaces spoken digits only in selected new development cases, recorded in scenario-version manifest.
No whole-task rerun, automatic model switch, model user/judge, holdout or architecture comparison. All retries/auxiliary model work count against the same caps.

On hard limit/auth/quota/protocol/security/unknown usage stop all subsequent requests. Persist first result and not_run reason. A receipt-based notice after stop cannot erase execution_stop or make frozen score pass.
ledger: Existing PilotGateway -> BailianAdapter/send_once -> BudgetLedger; no new provider or workbench real-mode opening.
diagnostic_requirement: Frozen grader unchanged; process-diagnostic-v5 records every quantity-bearing update_case/preview_action proposal against current user evidence before execution, backend rejections, later clarification recovery, final effects, receipt-bound notice and preserved model stops. A recovered guess remains a process defect.

continuation_policy.pending_matching_interrupt: Validate exact persisted confirmation event then resume its interrupt.
continuation_policy.ended_graph: Validate exact persisted confirmation event then use the same commit tool/business service; no model call is needed.
continuation_policy.duplicate_or_restart: Query committed receipt or execute the bound operation idempotently; never select an arbitrary CONFIRMED row.
continuation_policy.unknown_result: Query original preview operation only; never blindly write again.
continuation_policy.model_calls_after_confirmation: Only existing graph continuation can call the model; all such calls retain original ledger and limits.
continuation_policy.user_notice: Application notice must match receipt; preview text cannot satisfy final-notice diagnostics.
continuation_policy.known_pre_dispatch_budget_stop_after_com: Persist a final notice from the same approved preview receipt without a model request, return execution_stop, stop the batch and keep frozen task failure.
continuation_policy.known_model_stop_after_commit: Read only the same approved preview receipt, persist canonical final notice if present, preserve the original budget/provider/auth/usage/security/deadline execution_stop, unknown reserves and failing batch status. No extra model request or write retry. Missing receipt still raises original stop.

budget_change_note: New four-task priority scope with explicit heterogeneous token caps 48k/40k/40k/48k, total 176k. Not authorized. No transfer from any old batch or pending eight-task budget.
